forces: ⚠️ exfoliating/mottled bark — THE hard bark case (the second mask channel, §6)
descriptor: Multi-stemmed river birch; fine airy canopy; small diamond doubly-toothed leaves; yellow fall; SIGNATURE salmon-to-cinnamon papery exfoliating bark.
identityNotes: JUDGMENT CALL (reference research): River Birch — the standard heat-and-borer-tolerant urban-park birch for St. Louis / zone 6b (paper/white birches struggle here). Missouri native. Typically MULTI-STEMMED; the salmon-to-cinnamon peeling papery bark is its single most diagnostic feature (NOT the chalky white of paper birch).

referenceImages.caption: Multi-stem habit with fine open canopy; diamond-shaped doubly-toothed leaves (leaf detail: File:River_Birch_Betula_nigra_Leaf_2500px.jpg).
Yellow autumn foliage on the airy crown.
